title: Film title line: one centred line of heavy Mincho compressed to 0.40, a colon and a mark, an optional compressed English caption, on black
use: Film, season or campaign title frames; the opening and closing card of a trailer.

compress.note: the measured film step is 0.35; 0.40 keeps the open face's horizontals

height.note: title ink height as a share of the frame (measured 0.20-0.39)

caption.note: the compressed English line under the title

relations: One line centred, its vertical centre at 0.48 of the height.
Ideographs at 0.35-0.40 of their width; the colon 0.4 em; the mark 12% wider than the title.

provenance.corpus: tidemark case (潮位警报 TIDEMARK): our own original organisation terminal site, two app screens and UI kit in the crisis-command grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/crisis-command/style.json provenance (broadcast and film frames measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: per-glyph ink boxes on three film title cards (1920 x 1080, 1400 x 788, 1920 x 816): 新 劇 場 版 at 0.35 in all three, height 20-39% of the frame, centred (margins 148 / 143)
measured: Case: 潮位警报重编版：初 at 0 findings.
